summary: At the editor's go (25 Oct, in this session): every scheduled wake prompt made small. New admin/schedule/WAKE.md (pull dev, schedule.py wake <you> to see what changed, read card and brief, a run record every wake whatever happened, report). schedule.py: new 'wake' (commits since your last run, which of your instruction files changed, notes, inbox, card steps), 'run --publish' (pushes only the run record to runs/<agent>, no build or release, for the researcher, the curator and pulse, which do not release the site) and 'ingest' (the conductor carries those records into dev, refusing anything malformed); --read and --sent now accumulate. Cards: each one's new prompt in 'instructions', the old prompt kept word for word as the first step; pulse's card written from its scheduled task. The scheduled prompts change after this release.
